title: Barefoot Toddler by Wooden Chair, Backyard - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming full-length outdoor portrait of a barefoot toddler standing on gravelly ground, steadying himself against a dark wooden side table or chair. The toddler wears a vintage button-front romper with a wide white collar and scrunches up a gleeful, squinting smile in the bright sunlight. In the background, lush foliage and tree branches provide natural shade, capturing an everyday moment of early childhood from the 1930s.
